record.paper_title: Recent progress and open questions on the numerical index of Banach spaces
record.original_question: Let X be a complex Banach space such that its underlying real space X_R has the alternative Daugavet property. Determine whether X, equivalently X_R, must have the Daugavet property.

evidence.quote: Problem 34. Let X be a complex Banach space such that XR has the alternative Daugavet property. Does it follow that X (equivalently XR) has the Daugavet property?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A (real or complex) Banach space $X$ is said to have the Daugavet property if every bounded rank-one operator $T:X\to X$ satisfies the norm equality
$$\|\mathrm{Id}+T\| = 1+\|T\|.$$
A Banach space $X$ over the field $\mathbb{K}\in\{\mathbb{R},\mathbb{C}\}$ has the alternative Daugavet property if every bounded rank-one operator $T:X\to X$ satisfies
$$\max_{|\omega|=1}\|\mathrm{Id}+\omega T\| = 1+\|T\|,$$
where the maximum is taken over scalars $\omega\in\mathbb{K}$ of modulus one (equivalently, the same identity holds for every bounded operator $T:X\to X$).

Given a complex Banach space $X$, let $X_{\mathbb{R}}$ denote its underlying real Banach space, obtained by restricting the scalar multiplication to $\mathbb{R}$ while keeping the same norm.

Assume that $X_{\mathbb{R}}$ has the alternative Daugavet property. Does it follow that $X_{\mathbb{R}}$ (equivalently, $X$) has the Daugavet property?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not turn up a published resolution of this specific question. Recent work on the (super) alternative Daugavet property and on the Daugavet property in complex Banach spaces (e.g., a 2025 preprint on the super alternative Daugavet property and a 2023/2024 note on the Daugavet property for complex Banach spaces) addresses closely related themes but does not appear to settle the implication. The status is therefore taken to be unknown based on available evidence.

status_evidence.title: The super Alternative Daugavet property for Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces super ADP as strictly between Daugavet property and alternative Daugavet property; discusses complex vs real distinctions.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies properties between the Daugavet property and the alternative Daugavet property, indicating these are generally distinct and active areas of research.

status_evidence.title: Remark on the Daugavet property for complex Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the Daugavet property in complex Banach spaces via real-linear operators.
status_evidence.claim: Recent paper considers the Daugavet property in complex Banach spaces but does not appear to explicitly resolve whether ADP of X_R forces the Daugavet property.
